explication: ANTLR is a parser-generator toolchain with matching language runtimes. The documented workflow starts from a grammar and produces target-language parsers and tree APIs; those parsers tokenize input, recognize it, and expose parse trees for application processing. The graph preserves grammar transformation, semantic analysis, ATN analysis, and code generation, plus the major runtime stages and supported targets. Relationships among tool stages are supported by the SOURCE INDEX; runtime and target-language links are documented at a higher level in the README, since most runtime sources were not sampled.
